description: The Croatian Regulatory Authority for Network Industries publishes its geographic system of the transmitter list (GSPO) as ArcGIS feature services on its e-karta GIS server and as INSPIRE view and download services. The mobile service has layers for GSM (18,401 features), UMTS (5,267), LTE (82,698) and 5G NR (22,441). Each feature is a transmitter with technology, effective radiated power, installation type, operator, frequency, azimuth and height. Separate services hold digital terrestrial television (DVB-T2) and DAB radio transmitters. A related service maps 2,338 electromagnetic field measurement points with city, street address, coordinates, date, maximum measured field, campaign and a link to the measurement report. Coverage: Croatia. Format and access: ArcGIS REST feature services (JSON and GeoJSON queries), WMS and WFS 2.0, free; no licence was stated in the service metadata. Caveats: counts are transmitter or sector entries, not sites, so several features share one mast; the INSPIRE metadata gives a 2010 to 2016 temporal extent, although the services are current; the e-karta web viewer refused automated requests, while the REST services answered. Simulation uses: sector-level mobile network models with azimuth, height and power for coverage and exposure studies, and site locations for earthquake and wildfire exposure in Croatia. Related records: the HAKOM broadband availability and coverage maps give the resulting coverage; the Dutch Antenneregister and the UKE radio permit lists for Poland are comparable registers.
